# Missing test cases (Brief 2: test files only)

This list changed in Brief 3 because the upstream suite now includes the source doc tests.

23 of 100 deliberate changes were not detected by the 58 ported upstream tests. This is a bounded mutation study. It does not establish that these behaviours have no tests elsewhere in rust-lang/rust. Each proposed test passes on the restored copy and on real std 1.99.0. Each fails at runtime on its mutant. Formatting and error-text assertions record the current representation; a later documented policy change could require new expectations.

The port includes 47 coretests and 11 std value-type tests. DNS, UDP and ToSocketAddrs tests are excluded; see [PORTING.md](../acceptance/PORTING.md). All 58 ported tests stayed green for every row below. Exact names and output appear in each linked upstream log.
